photos.c: PHOTO (E.LACEY) Gerry North (30), running for Surrey in the Inter-Counties Champs. at the White City in June, is seen here just behind Barlow of Cheshire in the early stages of the race. The race was won by J. Alder in 28:04 and Gerry was 5th in 28:23.8. John Thresher was the other Belgrave member of the victorious Surrey team, finishing 6th in the mile with 4:05,8.
